donor_rule: The verified findings with at least one quote are sorted by (case id, position of the finding in its case). For the finding at place k of that order, the candidate donors of a kind are the findings, in the same order, of every case about a different company (other-company) or of every other case about the same company (other-claim). The donor is the first candidate, starting at place k modulo the number of candidates and wrapping round, that shares no quote with the finding: no whitespace-normalised quote of one equals, contains or is contained in a quote of the other. A finding with no candidate, or whose every candidate shares a quote, is skipped and counted. No randomness and no seed.

kinds.other-company: the quotes of a verified finding of a case about a different company
kinds.other-claim: the quotes of a verified finding of a different case about the same company

figures_note: Cited figures are dropped from every mismatched item, so its judgement rests on the swapped quotes alone; the true pairs were judged with their figures.
shows: Whether the meaning check, shown a verified finding's own statement and stance with real, verified quotes that belong to another finding, judges the pair not supported; beside it, how the same check judged the same statements with their own quotes.
does_not_show: Swapped quotes are an easy kind of mismatch: they are usually about another topic, and for other-company about another business, whose name or products may appear in them. Catching them says little about the hard case, a quote on the right topic that supports only a weaker or a different statement.
